DuskCjkTest.otf and DuskCjkVariableTest.otf are test-only subsets of
NotoSansCJKkr-VF.otf, from https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk.
They are not bundled with the application.

Original font SHA-256: 828d8415c3e601d1b7b94c2a86f8609ce4f78abebb92773724f3f004269059e8

The five real glyphs are U+65E5, U+4E2D, U+3042, U+30A2 and U+D55C.
U+4E00 through U+5E00 also alias the U+65E5 glyph (except the real U+4E2D)
to exercise cache capacity without thousands of fixture outlines.
The static fixture uses CFF; the variable fixture uses CFF2.
The font names were changed to DuskCjkTest. License: SIL OFL 1.1; see LICENSE.txt.
